name: The Orgrimmar Legion Needs Mojo!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for several unusual ingredients.  Given their current performance in Silithus, we'd like to comply with their request as soon as possible.  Gather the materials and bring them to the troll called Shai.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Powerful Mojo, 6 Flasks of Big Mojo and 8 Oils of Immolation to Shadow Priestess Shai near Hive'Regal in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, yes. Just what I needed! I'll make a special concoction with this. The silithid won't like it one bit!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have my materials, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IV
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IV

objectiveItems.name: Powerful Mojo
sources: High Priest Venoxis 24% in Zul'Gurub and 4 more
